title: SpaceX announces a senior unsecured notes offering and discloses that it has about $100.8B in cash; SPCX drops 8%+ (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
summary: Samantha Subin / CNBC: SpaceX announces a senior unsecured notes offering and discloses that it has about $100.8B in cash; SPCX drops 8%+ — - SpaceX launched an inaugural bond sale days after its blockbuster IPO … SpaceX on Monday announced a senior unsecured notes offering and disclosed about $100.8 billion in cash.
